review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded, faithful adaptation of official AMC 10B #15, p. 7. It preserves the exhaustive median cases while explaining the rank constraints and why each case selects the appropriate total.
review.annotationCheck: Mean, median, and range are all assessed through necessary constraints. Equal entries and boundary values are allowed and handled correctly; the surviving triples are verified.
